4.8 stars. 557 reviews. At a brunch café inside Chợ đêm Phú Quốc.

Most people walk past Ann Cafe & Brunch Phu Quoc looking for dinner. Big mistake. The daytime crowd here knows something the night market tourists don't.

Sit down, order slow, watch Đường Lê Thị Hồng Gấm wake up. $15-30 per person for a proper sit-down brunch on a Vietnamese island. That math hits different.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
